turns.text: You dispatch trains at Bramford Junction. Log these departures for the Elmshollow line: the express leaves at 20 minutes past the hour; the freight leaves at 10 minutes to the hour; the maintenance trolley runs only at noon. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
A passenger asks and you have no timetable in front of you: at how many minutes past the hour does the express to Elmshollow leave? Answer with just the number.
